name: Confluence CLI
description: Installs the kci-confluence-cli package from PyPI via uv (providing the `confluence` command) and exposes base_url / user_name / user_password options as the CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL / CONFLUENCE_USER_NAME / CONFLUENCE_USER_PASSWORD environment variables in the container.

base_url.description: Confluence base URL. Exposed in the container as the CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL environment variable.

user_name.description: Confluence user name. Exposed in the container as the CONFLUENCE_USER_NAME environment variable.

user_password.description: Confluence user password. Exposed in the container as the CONFLUENCE_USER_PASSWORD environment variable. NOTE: this value is written into the container image at build time; do not commit it to a shared devcontainer.json or push the built image.
